issue.title: Attachment store discovery ignores repos.sidecar.builtin.attachments-private.disabled once the hidden clone exists

task_type_fields.impact: A user who disables the private attachments sidecar after a clone was created (for example to stop attachment bytes leaving the machine) still uploads every new attachment. Workaround: pass `-L/--local-only` per attachment or delete the hidden clone.
task_type_fields.repro:
Root cause: `discover_shared_store()` in `src/sase/bead/attachments/upload/discovery.py` (and the doctor's `_clone_for_key()` in `src/sase/doctor/checks_attachment_store.py`) returns a `GitAttachmentStore` whenever the hidden bare clone `~/.sase/projects/<key>/repos/attachments-private` exists and has an `origin` remote. Neither consults the merged sidecar config, so `repos.sidecar.builtin.attachments-private.disabled: true` is ignored once a clone exists.

Repro (code read, sase master 63bde575f0): with an existing hidden clone that has a remote, set `repos.sidecar.builtin.attachments-private.disabled: true` in project config, then `sase bead note <id> "see @./file.txt"`: the write echo reports the private store destination and the bytes upload through the existing clone instead of staying local.

Found by the docs refresh agent in commit 28efa6f84c ("Suspected code issues: attachment upload discovery ignores a disabled sidecar when its clone remains"), which rewrote docs/beads.md and docs/init.md to document the current behavior; re-verified by the sase-1ck (bead note attachments) land agent. The epic originally documented that `disabled: true` keeps objects local.

Fix: resolve the project's merged sidecar entries (e.g. `configured_sidecar_roles(..., include_hidden=True)` or `merged_sidecar_entries_from_config`) for the resolved project key and treat a disabled attachments-private role as no store in discovery and the doctor check; then restore the docs promise. Coordinate with sase-1d5.4, which rewrites `discover_stores` per role (`hidden_clone_path(project_key, role)`); land after it to avoid colliding with that phase's salvaged diff.

issue.creation_reason: Found by docs commit 28efa6f84c and re-verified while landing epic sase-1ck: disabling the private attachments sidecar does not stop uploads through an existing clone, contrary to the epic's original contract.
